# SEYE Biomedical

> Guangzhou-based OEM, ODM and private-label skincare manufacturer. 80,000 m² of medical-grade
> production capacity, in-house R&D and quality control, export documentation for 30+ markets.
> Services: custom formulation, filling and assembly, regulatory support (GMPC, ISO 22716, US FDA,
> CPNP, BPOM, HALAL), packaging sourcing. Minimum order quantities in the low thousands per SKU,
> quoted against a specific packaging component.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/): company overview, capabilities, certifications, enquiry form
- [Insights](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/insights/): articles on manufacturing, quality control and sourcing
- [Contact](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/#contact): enquiry form, WhatsApp +86 180 4077 7742, inquiry@seyecosmetic.com

## Articles

- [Cosmetic Packaging: What Actually Sets Your MOQ, Cost and Lead Time](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/insights/cosmetic-packaging-moq-cost-lead-time/): Why the packaging component, not the formula, usually sets your cosmetic MOQ — component tiers, decoration minimums, compatibility tests and lead time anatomy.
- [How to Choose a Skincare OEM Manufacturer: What to Verify Before You Sign](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/insights/how-to-choose-a-skincare-oem-manufacturer/): A practical checklist for vetting skincare OEM and ODM factories: licences, formula ownership, in-process QC, MOQ terms, packaging and export documentation.
- [How to Read a Cosmetic Certificate of Analysis (and Spot a Fabricated One)](https://seye-cosmetic-site.pages.dev/insights/reading-a-cosmetic-certificate-of-analysis/): What a cosmetic CoA must contain, which results buyers misread — pH, viscosity, microbiological limits — and how to tell a genuine report from a template.
